content: AI test case generation from requirements: tools parse plain English, Gherkin, Jira user stories, requirements docs, screenshots, or live URLs to produce structured test cases with steps, expected results, edge cases, and boundary conditions. With well written requirements AI generated cases typically cover 60 to 80 percent of what a human tester would write, human review still essential for domain specific business logic and to avoid redundant or incorrect cases. AI enabled testing market roughly 1 billion USD in 2025, projected to reach nearly 4 billion by 2032.
